en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with a dominant Baroque onion‑domed church tower in the foreground, dense traditional houses with steep tiled roofs, several church spires, and in the background large factory buildings with tall chimneys. In the front are fenced vegetable plots and gardens, with a person working in the field. The landscape beyond the town is flat, open countryside. No visible printed title or caption appears on the image.
